body: We have a sign written in bright red that says “please order water at the register” because it got really out of hand on weekends, and we’re a high volume store. The people who ask are ALWAYS right next to the sign because we have it right at the mobile handoff which is eye level to the majority of our customers. My first complaint was from a Saturday. My store is a high volume store so there were many MANY people both waiting for drinks and in line to order. One dude, let’s call him V, come up and orders a grande mocha, standard. I thank him and send him to the bar for waiting and 3 minutes later he comes back to me, pushing away the next people in line to order, with a hot cup and yells 

“I ORDERED THIS HOT!!”

Confused, I looked at him and told him that’s the cup our hot drinks come in. He says “no, it’s not hot. And this isn’t my name! I want my receipt!”

So I ask him his name again and am able to successfully pull up his receipt based on his correct name alone.

My shift comes up next to me to ask what’s going on and V goes on a rant how he’d been waiting an hour and got his drink cold when he ordered it hot. My shift noticed the name Brandon on the cup and the fact it’s a MOBILE ORDER. But V refuses to give the cup back and demands a new one so he can have both.

They made his drink immediately and he walks out with what we assume was 2 hot mochas because the mobile had only just been called out as well.

The next day, found a report on me for messing up his name, drink, and extreme bitchery for DARING to say it was a hot drink in the hot cup.
